## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials & Industrials both negative, with Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows select leaders: META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples contributing: PM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology has notable laggards: NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -13.13% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft: CAT (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -7.29% | 1M: +2.95%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W: PANW (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND; watch TTWO (1W: +3.83% | 1M: -7.85%) RECOVERY as a potential short-term reversal. Note major divergence risk as several mega-cap techs show large 1W vs 1M splits — tactical, not confirmed broad rotation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with internal rotation and clear dispersion: AAPL (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.14% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: 9/24 positive → Internal Rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft overall: JPM (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.30%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth: 6/20 positive → Sector Weakness.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure with defensive names not holding up: AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -13.13% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -3.29%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: 4/17 positive → Sector Weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
In this RISK-OFF environment favor high-quality defensives and energy exposure while reducing exposure to cyclical and concentrated tech names showing below-trend breakdowns. Monitor PANW and TTWO for tactical recovery opportunities and watch NVDA/ASML/LRCX for potential trend breaks. Style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration among leaders.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (8/10 positive → Sector Strength) and select Communication/Tech leaders if momentum holds. BEARISH: Healthcare (4/17 positive → Sector Weakness), Materials and Industrials where earnings/contract risk appears priced in.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: failure to reclaim short-term highs after this 1W drop would confirm continued BELOW TREND and broaden tech weakness. META: hold above this week’s gains to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation. XOM: sustained 1M strength confirms Energy leadership; SLB weakness retest would warn of energy rotation. Monitor QCOM follow-through after chip-AI deal headlines.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
QCOM (+65): Amazon AI chip deal headline; QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
ASML (+65): JPM note on AI demand; ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price (distribution).  
BA (+60): $13.4B KC-46 contract; BA (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND — positive headline but price not confirming.  
MA (+50): cross-border deal; MA (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.30%) CORRECTION — sentiment partially confirming.  
LLY (+50): obesity access push; LLY (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND — headline positive but price lagging.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMGN (-50): drug question headline; AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND — news and price confirming downside.  
LRCX (-40): WFE/AI pacing concerns; LRCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND — news confirmed by steep price weakness.  
ASML (also shows bearish headlines -40): ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND — mixed signals in media but price is confirming weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and leadership concentrated (Narrow: 4/5 Technology).  
META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major divergence in chip/equipment names (ASML, LRCX, NVDA) where bullish headlines often diverge from falling prices — watch for trend breaks.
